description:
A wolverine weighs about 16 kg, yet it can kill a reindeer up to six times heavier. Doug follows the wolverine from the forest floor to the summit of Mount Cleveland, Glacier National Park's highest peak: the glutton legend, frozen food caches, raided traplines, a nose that finds dinner under almost two meters of snow, an 800 km walk to Colorado, snow dens, and a 1,500 m climb in about 90 minutes.

Which animal should Doug follow next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
